The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Two bugs were present in `rtl/pipe_stage.v`:
1. `in_ready` combinationally depended on `out_ready` (`!skid_valid || out_ready`), violating the spec's requirement that `in_ready` depend only on registered state. Fixed to `assign in_ready = !skid_valid;`.
2. `skid_valid` was never cleared after the skid word moved into the output register, so once a word entered the skid buffer it stayed "full" forever, breaking future pushes. Added `skid_valid <= 1'b0;` in that branch.
